title: Getting Started

modules.description: Inspect, hold, and tune your bansuri for the first time.

modules.description: Develop a steady Sa and build breath control.

description: Build a solid foundation from your first note to a complete saptak.

modules.description: Build alankars, discover lower Ni, and learn sargam theory.

modules.description: Expand from three notes to the full seven-note saptak.

description: Develop your technique, ear, and understanding of ragas.

modules.description: Read and write Indian and Western notation.

description: Deepen your knowledge of the 12-note system and explore ragas beyond Yaman.

modules.description: Master komal swaras and tivra Ma to unlock every note on the bansuri.

modules.description: Start with five-note ragas that build confidence and ear training.

modules.description: Explore ragas that use komal Ga and Ni - the emotional heart of Hindustani music.

modules.title: Advanced Ragas
modules.description: Tackle the most challenging ragas that test your full command of technique and theory.

description: From composition to performance - become a complete musician.
